o.text: Borrowed from Russian эскала́тор (eskalátor), derived from English escalator.
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *ẹrkek ~ *hẹrkek (“male”). Cognate with Turkish erkek.
Borrowed from Russian бактериолиз (bakterioliz). By surface analysis, bakterio- + -liz.
